question: The Janjira Fort is situated on a small island in the Arabian sea, off the coast of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Janjira is a colloquial and a more localized form of the **Arabic word Jazeera that means island**.
 
• The origin of this majestic fort can be traced down to the fifteenth century when some **local fishermen of Rajapuri** constructed a small **wooden fort on a huge rock** to protect themselves and their families from the pirate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is considered to be India's strongest marine fort. While some records state that it was built as early as **1100**, more recent records show that **Murud-Janjira was built at the end of the 17th c entury.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b15c8c9282071adc51b9cae5cedcb4b7c599c286303916e8a92ac48f2386aac5.png] **
